decisions.reason: Requiring both products to appear does not change the live-action, AI-method, or visual-realism constraints.
Product inclusion does not change the nationality or gender preferences for actors.
Including both products does not alter lip-sync accuracy or facial-expression requirements.
The source requires visual inclusion of both products but does not specify new benefits, keywords, or messaging for either product.
The number of products shown does not change the requirement for a viral creative style.
The instruction adds product-presentation content without changing the established reference-led creative concept or its relationship to the reference video.

The source requires both products in the video but does not change responsibility for sourcing the script, footage, or voiceover; product-image sourcing is already represented by the source Requirement.
Product inclusion does not alter the preview artifact, duration, language, or approval purpose.
The instruction concerns content within the current video and does not change video counts, formats, duration, or pilot-expansion conditions.
Including both products does not change subtitle presence, quality, or mobile formatting.
The source does not change how testimonial material is created or presented.
Product inclusion has no effect on the required audio-level standard.
